data_testid_convention.rule: Every button, input, table, form field, modal, select, tab, and key stat MUST have kebab-case data-testid.

image_urls.description: Modern architecture building exterior for setup and background visuals

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all code files are .js (or .jsx) as defined in the project setup.
Currency formatting utility MUST format integer kuruş to Turkish Lira string (e.g. integer 150000 -> ₺1.500,00 TR format with Intl.NumberFormat('tr-TR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' })).
Double-entry accounting journal entries must ensure sum(Borç) === sum(Alacak) before posting.
All navigation and action buttons must feature data-testid attributes.
Ensure Shadcn UI components (Select, Dialog, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Table, Toast) have explicit non-transparent backgrounds and full accessibility contrast.
Include local offline queue simulation in localStorage / IndexedDB with visual queue counter badge in topbar.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain 2x generous padding inside containers. Tables must be dense but legible with mono numbers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_states: Always specify explicit background and text color on hover. Never rely on transparent standard inheritance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios pass WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Use crisp micro-interactions via framer-motion (0.15s - 0.2s duration).
